description_en: Queries the quotas and usage of Alibaba Cloud CDN resources
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnUserQuota查询用户配额上限和余量信息
name: DescribeCdnUserQuota

BlockQuota.description_en: The maximum number of URLs and directories that can be blocked

BlockRemain.description_en: The remaining number of URLs and directories that can be blocked

DomainQuota.description_en: The maximum number of accelerated domain names
DomainQuota.description_zh: 加速域名数上限，单位：个

IgnoreParamsQuota.description_en: The maximum number of ignore params that can be refreshed
IgnoreParamsQuota.description_zh: 忽略参数刷新上限，单位：个

IgnoreParamsRemain.description_en: The remaining number of ignore params that can be refreshed
IgnoreParamsRemain.description_zh: 忽略参数刷新余量，单位：个

PreloadQuota.description_en: The maximum number of URLs that can be prefetched

PreloadRemain.description_en: The remaining number of URLs that can be prefetched

RefreshDirQuota.description_en: The maximum number of directories that can be refreshed

RefreshDirRemain.description_en: The remaining number of directories that can be refreshed

RefreshUrlQuota.description_en: The maximum number of URLs that can be refreshed

RefreshUrlRemain.description_en: The remaining number of URLs that can be refreshed
